#### 2. hypotrichosis 16  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.384)

**Why it matters:** Targeting the ADAM17/EGFR axis could offer a therapeutic strategy for both palmoplantar keratoderma-esophageal carcinoma syndrome and hypotrichosis 16, potentially through modulating EGFR signaling or its downstream effectors.
